TERMINAL_CONTROLLED.zh: 另一台设备正在控制这个终端
TERMINAL_CONTROLLED.en: Another device is controlling this terminal

TERMINAL_CONTROL_STALE.zh: 终端控制权已变更，请重新获取
TERMINAL_CONTROL_STALE.en: Terminal control changed; take control again

TERMINAL_DETACHED.zh: 终端正在重连，请稍后再试
TERMINAL_DETACHED.en: The terminal is reconnecting; try again shortly

TERMINAL_INTERACTION_BUSY.zh: 终端正在执行另一项操作，请稍后再试
TERMINAL_INTERACTION_BUSY.en: The terminal is busy with another operation; try again shortly

TERMINAL_LEASE_REQUIRED.zh: 获取控制权后才能输入
TERMINAL_LEASE_REQUIRED.en: Take control of the terminal before typing

TERMINAL_REBOUND.zh: 会话已切换到另一个终端，请重新提交消息
TERMINAL_REBOUND.en: The conversation moved to another terminal; send the message again
